steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Upload a brochure or a warranty once, and every client finds it in their portal.

steps.caption: Open any client
steps.narration: Open any client. Here, Caleb and Nora Hadley, in Austin.

steps.caption: Company pamphlets
steps.narration: At the bottom of the page is Company pamphlets.

steps.caption: Upload PDF
steps.narration: Choose Upload PDF, and pick the file.

steps.caption: Listed for the whole company
steps.narration: The file is listed here. It belongs to your whole company, not only to this client.

steps.caption: A client's portal
steps.narration: Now a client's screen. This is their portal.

steps.caption: From your company
steps.narration: On Home, under your company's name, is the file you uploaded.

steps.caption: Download
steps.narration: They choose Download to open it.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, open a different client.

steps.caption: The same file
steps.narration: The same file is on her page too. The bin removes it for everyone.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Company pamphlets is at the bottom of every client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: How to share a brochure with every client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Upload a brochure, a warranty or a care guide once in the ConstructHUB CRM and every client can download it from their portal. Recorded in a demo workspace with made-up clients and a sample PDF.
